text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - Algeria bought 75,000 tonnes of soft wheat at $174-$175 per tonne, C&F, for April/May shipment. Traders said the wheat was likely to come from France.

WHEAT SALE - Two Philippine flour mills bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for March/April shipment, including 13,750 tonnes of western white wheat at $157-$158 per tonne FOB PNW, 12,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat, 13 percent protein, for $183-$184 FOB, and 13,250 tonnes dark northern spring wheat, 14 percent protein at $186-$187 FOB.
